invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null List, as the final collect call produces a List (possibly empty).
The filtering step .filter(Objects::nonNull) ensures that there are no null elements in the returned list.
Each output record is a merge/reduction of records with the same key, so the output cannot have more records than the input.
Ensures all elements in the result are non-null, matching the explicit filter used prior to collecting to list.
The method always produces a List through the toList collector.
